entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="連中は何か企んでる。こっちも手を打っておかねえと" t="Heard they're planning something big. Gotta make sure we're prepped." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="連中は何か企んでる。こっちも手を打っておかねえと" t="Am auzit că pun ceva la cale. Trebuie să fim pregătiți." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私に3人ほどつけてよ。こっちから仕掛けてやる" t="Give me three people. I'll handle it – they won't know what hit 'em." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私に3人ほどつけてよ。こっちから仕掛けてやる" t="Dă-mi trei oameni. Mă ocup eu, habar n-au ce i-a lovit." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="今4人も失うリスクは負えねえよ。普段ならお前がどこで死のうが知ったこっちゃねえがな" t="Believe me, I'd love to get rid of four gonks. But sadly, that's a luxury I can't afford." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="今4人も失うリスクは負えねえよ。普段ならお前がどこで死のうが知ったこっちゃねえがな" t="Crede-mă, aș scăpa bucuros de patru fraieri. Da' acum nu-mi permit să pierd patru oameni." b="" a=""/>
